description: A sprite sheet of SIXTEEN separate game item icons arranged in a grid of 4 columns and 4 rows, each centered in its own cell, all small beige cloth seed pouches tied with string, each printed with a symbol: Row 1: rice, corn, tomato, watermelon. Row 2: grapes, chili pepper, tea leaf, sunflower. Row 3: glowing mushroom, moonflower, star fruit, golden wheat with sparkles. Row 4: a small apple tree sapling in a burlap root ball, a small orange tree sapling in a burlap root ball, a small peach tree sapling in a burlap root ball, a wooden watering can. Chunky simple game item icons, front view, thick dark outline, soft cel shading, every item fully separate on a plain flat solid bright magenta (#FF00FF) chroma-key background with empty space around it, no text, no numbers, no border, no frame
style_usage: Copy ONLY the art style of this reference: chunky chibi pixel art, thick dark outline on every shape, soft cel shading, front-facing view, one object centered in each cell. Do not copy these objects, their colors or their layout.
